title: Cute Coasters
text: Cute Coasters. These are cute coasters. They're fabric and absorb moisture well. I have been hesitant to use them on wood surfaces because they don't have any backing to them so I would imagine that the moisture could go all the way through if your cup leaked or spilled.

product_metadata.title: Vera Bradley Coasters Set of 4
features: MACHINE WASHABLE RECYCLED COTTON – The cotton fabric that you’re familiar with has been reimagined; the exterior fabric is made with 50% recycled cotton fibers and has all of the comfort, softness, and vibrancy that you know and love.
SET OF 4 -- this beautiful set of four coasters add a beautiful pop of color to your living space while keeping your furniture clean
PERFECTLY SIZED -- each coaster measures 4.5 inches in diameter
CARE -- Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, only non-chlorine bleach when needed; tumble dry low
GIFT FOR HER - Great gift for the woman in your life for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, & Mother's Day
